extracted.name: Easy Creamed Spinach
extracted.description: Spinach is simmered with cream of mushroom soup, butter and garlic salt. It doesn’t get much easier than this!
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Prepare spinach according to package directions; drain well.
Combine spinach, condensed cream of mushroom soup, and butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through and bubbling, about 5 minutes.
Season with garlic salt to taste and serve hot.
